achievement_survive_one_day.name: [Survival] The First Day of the Rest of their Unlives
achievement_survive_one_day.description: Survive for a day and find a safe place to sleep

achievement_survive_91_days.name: [Survival] A Time to Every Purpose Under Heaven

achievement_marathon.name: [Travel] Pheidippides Was a Hack
achievement_marathon.description: Run a marathon…plus a little bit more.

achievement_walk_1000_miles.name: [Travel] Please Don't Fall Down at My Door

achievement_mutation_threshold_alpha.name: [Mutation] More Human Than Human
achievement_mutation_threshold_alpha.description: You've evolved beyond your constraints.  You are now a post-threshold Prime mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_bear.name: [Mutation] Just the Necessities
achievement_mutation_threshold_bear.description: Now you're armed for bear!  You are now a post-threshold Bear mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_beast.name: [Mutation] The Nature of the Me
achievement_mutation_threshold_beast.description: Your number has come up.  You are now a post-threshold Beast mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_bird.name: [Mutation] The Modern-Day Dinosaur
achievement_mutation_threshold_bird.description: I can see my house from here!  You are now a post-threshold Bird mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_cattle.name: [Mutation] Don't Drive a Limousine, Become It
achievement_mutation_threshold_cattle.description: Is that red you see?  No, just movement.  You are now a post-threshold Bovine mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_cephalopo.name: [Mutation] How Did I Ever Get Surrounded by Such Undead Neighbors?
achievement_mutation_threshold_cephalopo.description: From the depths, something stirs!  You are now a post-threshold Cephalopod mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_chimera.name: [Mutation] Equal Opportunity Assimilator
achievement_mutation_threshold_chimera.description: What even ARE you anymore?  You are now a post-threshold Chaos mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_feline.name: [Mutation] Nine Lives
achievement_mutation_threshold_feline.description: It wasn't monday you hated, it was the grind.  You are now a post-threshold Feline mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_fey.name: [Mutation] The Fair Folk
achievement_mutation_threshold_fey.description: The iron may be cold, but it still suits you.  You are now a post-threshold Fey mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_fish.name: [Mutation] Tipping the Scales
achievement_mutation_threshold_fish.description: Swim swim hungry!  You are now a post-threshold Aquatic mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_insect.name: [Mutation] Heard of the Swarm?
achievement_mutation_threshold_insect.description: One's opinion on jazz is actually irrelevant to the rest of the hive.  You are now a post-threshold Insect mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_lizard.name: [Mutation] You Feel Limber
achievement_mutation_threshold_lizard.description: No, eating you will not cure petrification.  You are now a post-threshold Lizard mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_medical.name: [Mutation] What Doesn't Kill You, Makes You Stranger
achievement_mutation_threshold_medical.description: Through the power of science!  And also drugs.  You are now a post-threshold Prototype mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_mouse.name: [Mutation] Judge Me by My Size
achievement_mutation_threshold_mouse.description: You're more in the mood for peanut butter rather than cheese.  You are now a post-threshold Diminutive mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_mycus.name: [Mutation] Mycus Must Grow
achievement_mutation_threshold_mycus.description: The Fruit, the Seed, the Sap.  Consume this, and we will be as one, to bring unity to this world.

achievement_mutation_threshold_plant.name: [Mutation] Carbon Neutral
achievement_mutation_threshold_plant.description: As the ivy conquers ruined stone, so shall we regrow.  You are now a post-threshold Plant mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_rabbit.name: [Mutation] Finally beat the tortoise…
achievement_mutation_threshold_rabbit.description: You finally won the race against the tortoise.  You are now a post-threshold Rabbit mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_rat.name: [Mutation] At First I Was Afraid, I Was Petrified…
achievement_mutation_threshold_rat.description: You're the giant rat (er sorry, survivor) that makes all of the rules.  You are now a post-threshold Survivor mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_raptor.name: [Mutation] Clever Girl
achievement_mutation_threshold_raptor.description: Be what you want to be, the only creatures that could tell you otherwise are made of meat.  You are now a post-threshold Raptor mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_serpent.name: [Mutation] No Step On Snek
achievement_mutation_threshold_serpent.description: Legs are for chumps.  You are now a post-threshold Serpent mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_slime.name: [Mutation] Slippery When Moist
achievement_mutation_threshold_slime.description: A slime draws near!  Wait, that's just your reflection.  You are now a post-threshold Aqueous mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_spider.name: [Mutation] With Great Power…
achievement_mutation_threshold_spider.description: …comes a lot of silk getting stuck to your chitin.  You are now a post-threshold Arachnid mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_troglobit.name: [Mutation] Spelunking: A Lifestyle, Not a Hobby
achievement_mutation_threshold_troglobit.description: Raise your pick and raise your voice!  You are now a post-threshold Subterranean mutant.

achievement_mutation_threshold_wolf.name: [Mutation] Leader of the Pack
achievement_mutation_threshold_wolf.description: Fine, you'll start your own furry convention, with blackjack and hookers.  You are now a post-threshold Wolf mutant.

achievement_lvl_5_archery.name: [Skill] Bull's Eye
achievement_lvl_5_archery.description: Wilhelm Tell?  Never heard of him.

achievement_lvl_5_barter.name: [Skill] Free Trader
achievement_lvl_5_barter.description: Extraordinary gizmos for obscenely low prices!

achievement_lvl_10_barter.name: [Skill] Robber Baron
achievement_lvl_10_barter.description: It's gettin' tougher and tougher to make an honest buck these days!

achievement_lvl_5_bashing.name: [Skill] Batter
achievement_lvl_5_bashing.description: Every strike brings me closer to a home run.

achievement_lvl_10_bashing.name: [Skill] Stone Age
achievement_lvl_10_bashing.description: The cudgel was humanity's first tool.  And it may be it's last, so why not master it?

achievement_lvl_5_computer.name: [Skill] Hack the Planet
achievement_lvl_5_computer.description: This OS has a back door.  there is always a back door.

achievement_lvl_10_cooking.name: [Skill] Hell's Kitchen
achievement_lvl_10_cooking.description: Today's menu: Soupe a l'oignon, Boeuf Bourguignon and Creme brulee.

achievement_lvl_5_cutting.name: [Skill] Way of the Sword
achievement_lvl_5_cutting.description: When the sword is once drawn, the passions of men observe no bounds of moderation.

achievement_lvl_10_cutting.name: [Skill] Sword-Saint
achievement_lvl_10_cutting.description: The sword has to be more than a simple weapon; it has to be an answer to life's questions.

achievement_lvl_5_dodge.name: [Skill] Elusive
achievement_lvl_5_dodge.description: The strongest of blows is nothing if it doesn't land.

achievement_lvl_10_driving.name: [Skill] Bottom Gear
achievement_lvl_10_driving.description: Formula One is for Sunday drivers.

achievement_lvl_5_electronics.name: [Skill] Thunder Ohm
achievement_lvl_5_electronics.description: Two volts enter, one volt leaves.  Resistance is futile.

achievement_lvl_10_electronics.name: [Skill] Full Bridge Rectifier
achievement_lvl_10_electronics.description: One does not simply taste a 9V battery.

achievement_lvl_5_fabrication.name: [Skill] Do-It-Yourselfer
achievement_lvl_5_fabrication.description: Take this thing, put it in that thing, and voila.

achievement_lvl_10_fabrication.name: [Skill] Jack of All Trades
achievement_lvl_10_fabrication.description: With a right amount of glue, there is nothing I can't do.

achievement_lvl_5_firstaid.name: [Skill] Medic!
achievement_lvl_5_firstaid.description: Is there a doctor in the house?

achievement_lvl_10_launcher.name: [Skill] Rocket Man
achievement_lvl_10_launcher.description: I'm sending you to the moon.  In pieces.

achievement_lvl_10_mechanics.name: [Skill] Captain of the R-MCC Landship
achievement_lvl_10_mechanics.description: This whole deal is holding on faith, spit and duct tape.

achievement_lvl_5_melee.name: [Skill] Brawler
achievement_lvl_5_melee.description: Bottle in left hand, chair leg in right hand.

achievement_lvl_10_melee.name: [Skill] Street Fighter
achievement_lvl_10_melee.description: It's winning that matters, not the style.

achievement_lvl_5_pistol.name: [Skill] Small but Deadly
achievement_lvl_5_pistol.description: Caliber doesn't count when you're on the receiving side of the barrel.

achievement_lvl_10_pistol.name: [Skill] Big Iron
achievement_lvl_10_pistol.description: Six bullets.  More than enough to kill anything that moves.

achievement_lvl_5_rifle.name: [Skill] Rifleman
achievement_lvl_5_rifle.description: This is my rifle.  there are many like it, but this one is mine.  My rifle is my best friend.  It is my life.  I must master it as I must master my life.

achievement_lvl_10_rifle.name: [Skill] Soldier
achievement_lvl_10_rifle.description: Without me, my rifle is useless.  Without my rifle, I am useless.  I will keep my rifle clean and ready, even as I am clean and ready.  We will become part of each other.

achievement_lvl_5_shotgun.name: [Skill] Double Barrel, Double Fun
achievement_lvl_5_shotgun.description: I like to keep this handy for close encounters.

achievement_lvl_10_shotgun.name: [Skill] This is My Boomstick!
achievement_lvl_10_shotgun.description: Both barrels for you, you bastards.

achievement_lvl_5_smg.name: [Skill] Spray'n'Pray
achievement_lvl_5_smg.description: One will hit.  It's a matter of statistics.

achievement_lvl_10_speech.name: [Skill] Silver Tongue
achievement_lvl_10_speech.description: Legend has it that you convinced a zombie hulk to go away.

achievement_lvl_5_stabbing.name: [Skill] Lancer
achievement_lvl_5_stabbing.description: He learned to deal the far-off stone, and poke the long, safe spear.

achievement_lvl_10_stabbing.name: [Skill] Five Finger Fillet
achievement_lvl_10_stabbing.description: Is this a dagger which I see before me, the handle toward my hand?  Come, let me clutch thee.

achievement_lvl_10_survival.name: [Skill] Innawoods
achievement_lvl_10_survival.description: Some people think I'm over-prepared.  Paranoid.  Maybe even a little crazy.  But they never met any Precambrian life forms, did they?

achievement_lvl_10_swimming.name: [Skill] Sky of Blue, and Sea of Green

achievement_lvl_5_tailor.name: [Skill] Tailor
achievement_lvl_5_tailor.description: A needle, a thread and a dream.

achievement_lvl_10_tailor.name: [Skill] Fashion Designer
achievement_lvl_10_tailor.description: Male, female and mutant fashion alike.

achievement_lvl_10_throw.name: [Skill] Frag Out!
achievement_lvl_10_throw.description: This sounds like a job for Ambassador Pineapple.

achievement_lvl_5_traps.name: [Skill] Trapper
achievement_lvl_5_traps.description: A good trap doesn't discriminate between beavers and zombeavers.

achievement_lvl_10_traps.name: [Skill] Minesweeper
achievement_lvl_10_traps.description: All it takes is one mistake.

achievement_lvl_5_unarmed.name: [Skill] Road to Shaolin
achievement_lvl_5_unarmed.description: I feel an army in my fist.
